most_similar_reason: Candidate 10 matches the target's core arc most closely: a civilizing deity who comes to earth, appears among towns teaching religion and the foundations of civilization, is linked to sun/light and to the ordering of a great sacred city, and is remembered in multiple conflicting versions.
least_similar_reason: Candidate 9 shares almost nothing with the target—it is a sky-woman fall, turtle-earth, and twin-brothers creation tale whose gifts are food plants grown from a corpse, with no descending civilizing teacher, no cave consultation by chiefs, no sacred sun temple, and none of the target's odd cat/wind/idol identifications.
